findings.message: This will deadlock due to issues with the lock order. You are locking two resolvers (this one and the current thread's solver) simultaneously without specifying an order.
findings.tp_fp_justification: lrh2000: acquiring a second fs resolver write lock (`let mut fs_resolver = fs.resolver().write();`) while already holding one creates a lock-ordering deadlock between two resolvers. Confirmed present at exam_head L309.

lrh2000: 'In addition, I think you miss the following checks. If you don't check self.root, some panics below may be reachable.' The validation block (L250-258) lacks a self.root branch, so `self.root.mount.parent().unwrap().upgrade().unwrap()` / `mountpoint().unwrap()` at L288-289 can panic. Comment anchored at L248; defect at L288-289 (API-confirmed).
